policy: Additive-only within /v1: existing fields never change type or meaning and are never removed; new fields may appear. Breaking changes would ship as /v2 with /v1 kept alive. Current schema version is sent on every response as X-Schema-Version.

changes: ADD a free tier: the first 25 paid-route calls per client per day return real data with NO payment, then the normal 402 resumes. No wallet needed to use the service; response headers X-Free-Tier-Remaining / X-Free-Tier report where a caller stands. Prices, the 402 body, and the published payment terms are UNCHANGED — this only adds a way to call the routes without paying
NOTE the free tier never applies to the directory-probe PINs or route-template URLs, which continue to return 402 so listing verification is unaffected

ADD MCP payment interop with the agents-SDK x402 convention (Cloudflare agents/x402): paid MCP tools return the 402 under _meta['x402/error'] (isError), accept the signed payment via _meta['x402/payment'], surface settle receipts as _meta['x402/payment-response'], and carry agents-x402/priceUSD tool _meta; /v1 HTTP routes unchanged

FIX 402 accepts.extra + discovery-extension strings are now pure ASCII: non-ASCII (em dashes) was mojibake'd in the 402 body and crashed btoa()-based x402 payment clients (Cloudflare agents-SDK) when echoed into the payment payload
HARDEN payment-header guards (HEAD never settles, size cap, replay pre-check) now cover the x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header as well as legacy X-PAYMENT
PRICE /v1/search is now FREE (was $0.01) — no payment, no auth; the PIN routes remain pay-per-call
HARDEN HEAD requests never settle a payment; root cache is private; q-value-aware content negotiation; POST / answers JSON-RPC instead of 405
ADD per-response provenance: as_of, source, cite
ADD free live example PINs (golden PINs) on paid routes
ADD X-Schema-Version header; HEAD support; ETag caching on discovery surfaces
ADD llms.txt, agents.txt, sitemap, robots, security.txt, favicon, /.well-known/{agent.json,mcp,mcp.json}
Initial public release: /v1/{search,parcel,dossier,comps} behind x402; /v1/sample free; A2A card; x402 resource list
